record_title: Binary classification of even exactly k-deficient-perfect numbers with two prime factors
scientific_context: For n=2^a p^b with p odd, exact k-deficient-perfectness is characterized completely by a short prime interval. Base-p uniqueness forces a unique deficient-divisor set, whose cardinality is an explicit binary Hamming-weight formula.
limitations: The theorem treats even integers with exactly two distinct prime factors. It does not classify odd cases or support of size at least three, nor does it settle infinitude for a fixed k. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; poorly indexed divisor-partition literature or later work under different terminology remains the principal residual risk.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact subset-sum verification of the theorem on 672 bounded parameter triples.
Deterministic verification output: 92 qualifying triples and zero mismatches.
